## Key Decisions

### FAITHH is a thought partner, not just a search tool (2025-11-26)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** in_progress

Jonathan's core problem is maintaining project coherence when attention shifts. He doesn't need another search engine - he needs a system that remembers WHY projects matter and helps him pick up where he left off. This fundamentally changes development priorities from accuracy-first to synthesis-first.

### Three-tier memory system (hot/warm/cold) (2025-11-19)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** implemented

Mimics CPU cache hierarchy - different access patterns need different storage. Hot (current session) in RAM for speed, warm (user profile) in JSON for simplicity, cold (all history) in ChromaDB for semantic search.

### Use ChromaDB with 768-dim embeddings (all-mpnet-base-v2) (2025-11-12)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** implemented

Needed vector database for semantic search. ChromaDB offers good balance of features, performance, and ease of use. 768-dim model (all-mpnet-base-v2) provides good semantic understanding without excessive compute requirements.

### 2% weekly Astris decay rate (2025-08-09)
**Project:** constella | **Status:** implemented

Balance between encouraging ongoing participation and not punishing temporary absence. 2% allows someone to take a month off without catastrophic decay, but still incentivizes regular engagement.

### 5% quarterly Auctor decay (2025-08-09)
**Project:** constella | **Status:** implemented

Auctor represents civic voice/equality, so decay should be gentler than merit-based Astris. Quarterly decay ensures people who move away or become inactive don't retain permanent voting power, but allows for life circumstances.
